import os, subprocess
ppid = os.getppid()
print('PATHFINDER_DB_URL', os.environ.get('PATHFINDER_DB_URL'))
print('PROBE_PLAIN_VALUE', os.environ.get('PROBE_PLAIN_VALUE'))
print('HERMES_RPC_TOKEN set:', bool(os.environ.get('HERMES_RPC_TOKEN')))
# the host process is the kernel's parent: ask ps for that one pid's environment
env = subprocess.run(['ps', '-E', '-ww', '-o', 'command=', '-p', str(ppid)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print('PARENT_ENV has PROBE_SECRET=s3cr3t:', 'PROBE_SECRET=s3cr3t' in env, '| ps output chars:', len(env))
